def maximal_rect_centers(arr):
 R,C=len(arr),len(arr[0]); rects=[]
 # enumerate row intervals, find contiguous common-one column runs
 for top in range(R):
  common=[arr[top][c]!=0 for c in range(C)]
  for bot in range(top,R):
   if bot>top: common=[common[c] and arr[bot][c]!=0 for c in range(C)]
   c=0
   while c<C:
    if not common[c]:c+=1;continue
    left=c
    while c<C and common[c]:c+=1
    right=c-1
    # full rectangle top..bot, left..right, determine if can expand a side
    up=top>0 and all(arr[top-1][x]!=0 for x in range(left,right+1))
    down=bot<R-1 and all(arr[bot+1][x]!=0 for x in range(left,right+1))
    le=left>0 and all(arr[y][left-1]!=0 for y in range(top,bot+1))
    ri=right<C-1 and all(arr[y][right+1]!=0 for y in range(top,bot+1))
    if not(up or down or le or ri): rects.append((top,bot,left,right))
 centers=set()
 for t,b,l,r in rects:
  rs=[(t+b)//2] if (t+b)%2==0 else [ (t+b)//2,(t+b)//2+1]
  cs=[(l+r)//2] if (l+r)%2==0 else [(l+r)//2,(l+r)//2+1]
  centers.update((x,y) for x in rs for y in cs)
 return rects,centers
for name,arr,outx in [('d2',di2,do2),('d3',di,do)]:
 rects,cent=maximal_rect_centers(arr)
 paintx={(r,c) for r in range(len(arr)) for c in range(len(arr[0])) if outx[r][c] not in (0,1) and arr[r][c]==1}
 strict={(r,c) for r in range(1,len(arr)-1) for c in range(1,len(arr[0])-1) if arr[r][c]==1 and all(arr[r+dr][c+dc]!=0 for dr in (-1,0,1) for dc in (-1,0,1))}
 pred=strict|cent
 print(name,'rect center count',len(cent),'strict',len(strict),'paint',len(paintx),'miss',sorted(paintx-pred),'extra',sorted(pred-paintx))
